thesis: Matt Spielman argues that the majority of professionals in asset management live lives of quiet desperation, waiting for paychecks rather than engaging with their work, a pattern he observed during his time on the trading floor. He explains that this realization led him to leave the industry and pursue executive coaching to help leaders find their own path and avoid that state of disengagement.
